known_sources_from_DATA_HANDOFF: Likely Kaggle warcoder/tyre-quality-classification merged and SHA-1 renamed

held_out_test_metrics.dataset: ATIS_Dataset/test (152 cracked / 146 normal), threshold swept on ATIS_Dataset/val
held_out_test_metrics.note: Production default ATIS_CONF_THRESHOLD=0.60 is above the minimum qualifying sweep threshold (0.50), i.e. at least as defect-catching. These are curated-dataset metrics; field validation on target checkpoint cameras is still required (see known_limitations).

inference_policy.safe_decision: safe only when predicted class is normal and top-1 confidence is greater than or equal to ATIS_CONF_THRESHOLD
inference_policy.unsafe_decision: cracked/crack/cracking predictions are unsafe at any confidence; low-confidence normal is unsafe for manual review

localization.purpose: visual marker boxes for likely crack regions
localization.limitations: Boxes are visual aids and should not be reported as detector mAP or per-defect localization metrics.

architecture_decision.decision: Keep classifier plus heuristic localizer for the current product path.
reasoning: The committed trained artifact is an image-level normal/cracked classifier, not a bounding-box detector.
No evaluated trained detector weights or per-defect mAP artifacts are present in the repo.
The classifier path is covered by application tests and current UI behavior.
train_detector.py remains available for a future switch after a detection dataset, detector weights, and honest detector evaluation are committed.
switch_to_detector_when: A YOLO detection dataset with clean negatives and labelled tire-defect boxes is committed or documented as an external artifact.
Detector weights are available through the agreed model-artifact policy.
Evaluation reports per-class precision, recall, mAP, and product-level false-pass/false-flag rates.
The Flask inference path and tests consume detector result objects directly.

known_limitations: Dataset distribution is mostly controlled/studio or web imagery, not validated for all highway checkpoint lighting and camera angles.
The model only distinguishes normal vs cracked tyres; bulge, puncture, flat spot, inflation, and tread-depth classes are out of scope.
Night and low-light operation requires controlled lighting or new representative data.
The non-tyre gate is best-effort and should not be treated as a certified tire detector.
